title: བདེ་སྐྱིད་གི་སོར་རྟགས།
description: Dekyi has a beautiful ring to show her friend Drolma. On the way, a curious bird startles Dekyi, and once they arrive, baby Padma goes missing -- leading to a surprising discovery about where the ring went.
